paragraphs.text: Ali from Cairo was a mysterious human from Rabiah , who could be seen carrying a necklace set with a large green gemstone.

In One Thousand and One Nights , the inspiration for the set Arabian Nights , Ali was a prince who traveled far to find the most extraordinary, rare object for his love. When first printed in Arabian Nights , Ali had the unique Creature type of Ali from Cairo . This was given errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to be Human .
